text:
PSC::calling_id
Description
The PSC::calling_id command gets the calling station id or sets the
calling station id when the optional is given.
Syntax
PSC
::
calling_id
PSC
::
calling_id
<
value
>
PSC::calling_id
retrieve the calling station id
PSC::calling_id <value>
set the calling station id
